Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 2 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line
Issued at: 11:00 AM, 15 November 2025(Saturday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Nueva Ecija(Gabaldon, General Tinio, San Isidro, Cabiao, San Leonardo, Gapan, San Antonio, Penaranda, Jaen), Bulacan(Dona Remedios Trinidad, San Miguel), Pampanga(Arayat, Candaba, Magalang, Porac, Angeles, Mabalacat), Zambales(San Marcelino, Botolan, San Felipe, Cabangan, San Narciso) and Tarlac(Concepcion).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Quezon(General Nakar, Panukulan, Burdeos, Patnanungan, Polillo, Jomalig, Infanta), Rizal(Rodriguez, San Mateo, Antipolo, Tanay), Metro Manila(Quezon City, Caloocan, Valenzuela, Malabon, Navotas, Manila, Marikina), Nueva Ecija(Laur, Bongabon, Palayan, Cabanatuan, Santa Rosa, Aliaga, Zaragoza, Licab, Quezon, Talavera, General Mamerto Natividad, Santo Domingo, Llanera, Rizal) and Tarlac(La Paz, Bamban, Capas, San Jose, Tarlac City) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate rains affecting Bulacan(San Ildefonso, Hagonoy, Paombong, Malolos, Guiguinto, Plaridel, Pandi, San Rafael, Baliuag, Bustos, Angat, Pulilan, Calumpit), Pampanga(Santa Ana, San Fernando, Mexico, Bacolor, San Luis, San Simon, Apalit, Santo Tomas, Minalin, Macabebe, Masantol, Sasmuan, Lubao, Guagua, Santa Rita, Floridablanca), Bataan(Orani, Hermosa, Dinalupihan) and Zambales(Subic, Olongapo, Castillejos, San Antonio) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZISbP.

ISANG ARAW BAGO ANG RALLY

Nakahanda na ang NCR police para sa gaganaping rally ng iba't ibang grupo sa EDSA People Power Monument sa Linggo, Nov. 16.

Naka-full alert status na rin ang Police Regional Office 3 (PRO3) para suportahan ang NCRPO.

Mahigit 2,200 tauhan ang ilalagay para sa seguridad ng publiko, at crowd management. | via Arvin Rillera & Floyd Pajas, News5 Cameramen
